about: The transactions docs/PROOF.md is built from, by section, with what was recorded for each when it was sent. `npm run proof` (in e2e/) re-reads every one from the chain and writes docs/PROOF.md. Everything recorded in deployments/*.json and eval/*/anchor.json, and every explorer link in the docs, is checked too; those are read from the files themselves.

runs.e2e: The end-to-end run against the current hub (`npm run live`), 2026-10-28
runs.risk: The risk module's runs (`npm run risk`), 2026-10-28, recorded in deployments/risk.json
runs.app: A run through the web app's pages (a preview deployment) and the MCP server, 2026-10-29
